usageNotes: Use this to verify a notification target is reachable and correctly configured before relying on it for alerts. The caller must hold at least Mapping.Audit, Mapping.Use, or Mapping.Modify on /mapping/notifications. The endpoint returns null synchronously — a missing error response indicates success, while an HTTP error body describes the delivery failure.

examples.summary: Send a test notification to the 'ops-slack' target

tips: The target name must match a pve-configid (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores; no spaces) — use get_cluster_notifications_targets to list valid names.
A 200 response with null body means the test message was dispatched; verify delivery on the receiving end (email inbox, webhook log, etc.) since PVE does not confirm downstream receipt.
If the target's back-end service (SMTP relay, Gotify, webhook URL) is temporarily unreachable, this call will return an error — useful for pre-maintenance smoke tests.
